# UI & Design System Requirements Quality Checklist: TUI Design System

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("Unit Tests for English") validating completeness, clarity, consistency, coverage, measurability, and accessibility for the `leiden-tui` Design System specification and plan.
**Created**: 2026-09-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Color Palette & Token Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are all four distinct color layers (Base, Text, Accent, Community) explicitly enumerated with concrete RGB values and purpose descriptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Data-Model §1]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the 12-color community hashing palette fully defined with deterministic modulo mapping formulas? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK003 - Are 16-color ANSI and 256-color fallback tokens completely specified for every RGB color constant? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Contracts §1.2]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the true-color detection precedence order (`COLORTERM` primary vs `TERM` heuristic fallback) unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Data-Model §1.5]
- [x] CHK005 - Are default fallback assumptions explicitly defined when neither true-color nor recognized terminals are detected? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Research §R-005]

---

## 2. Typography, Modifiers & Formatting Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is the strict prohibition of `Modifier::ITALIC` accompanied by explicit substitute modifiers (`DIM`, `UNDERLINED`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the selection styling requirement specified using explicit tokens (`BG_3` + `FG_0`) rather than ambiguous reverse-video modifiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Data-Model §3.2]
- [x] CHK008 - Are numeric formatting specifications quantified with exact decimal precisions for all metric classes (modularity, ΔQ, gamma, node/edge counts)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK009 - Is signed representation explicitly mandated for delta modularity (ΔQ) across positive, zero, and negative values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §US-7]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the complete permitted Unicode BMP character set cataloged with codepoints and ASCII fallbacks? [Completeness, Design-System §4.3, Plan §Constraints]
  - **Note**: The cross-reference originally pointed to "Spec §4.3" but `spec.md` has no numbered §4.x sections. The complete Unicode catalog with codepoints and ASCII fallbacks lives in `design-system.md §4.3` — a separate reference document, not the feature spec. The requirement-quality criterion itself is fully satisfied; only the section label in the checklist cross-reference was inaccurate (now corrected to `design-system.md §4.3`).
- [x] CHK011 - Is the prohibition against emoji characters stated with verifiable boundary criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009, Contracts §3]

## 3. Responsive Layout & Breakpoint Coverage

- [x] CHK012 - Are the width boundaries for all four layout modes (`Full` ≥120, `Compact` 80–119, `Stacked` 60–79, `Minimal` <60) exhaustive with zero overlapping or unhandled column widths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Data-Model §4.1]
- [x] CHK013 - Are panel dimensional proportions and constraints specified for every layout mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK014 - Does the spec define space redistribution rules for all combinations of panel toggles (`g`/`l`) across all four layout modes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §US-3]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the behavior specified for the terminal height boundary when rendered below the minimum 24-row baseline? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Quickstart §Prerequisites]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the immutability/permanence of the Community panel explicitly defined when other panels are hidden? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Data-Model §8]

---

## 4. State Theming, Focus & Interaction Consistency

- [x] CHK017 - Does each `AppState` variant (`Idle`, `Running`, `Done`, `Error`) map to a mutually exclusive and perceptually distinct (Color + Symbol + Label) triple? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 - Are border styling transitions between focused (`ACCENT_PRIMARY`) and unfocused (`FG_3`) states consistent across all panels? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK019 - Are focus cycle (`Tab`) skipping rules unambiguously defined when panels are hidden via toggles? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US-5]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the `Tab` key behavior specified when only a single panel is visible (e.g., in `Minimal` layout mode)? [Edge Case, Spec §US-5, Contracts §2.3]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the error recovery interaction (`Error` → `Idle` on key press) specified to preserve existing log ring buffer contents? [Consistency, Spec §US-1, Spec §FR-003]

---

## 5. Widget Styling & Cross-Panel Consistency

- [x] CHK022 - Is cross-panel community color parity (Community Panel block matching Graph View node color for community ID `N % 12`) specified without ambiguity? [Consistency, Spec §US-2, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the community color block explicitly preserved in its base community color when a table row is selected? [Clarity, Spec §US-2, Spec §5.1]
- [x] CHK024 - Are log message severity levels (`ERROR`, `WARN`, `INFO`, `DEBUG`, `TRACE`) mapped to specific colors and font weight modifiers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data-Model §4.4]
- [x] CHK025 - Are the fixed-window capacity (20 iterations) and auto-scaling rules for the quality sparkline explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §US-7]
- [x] CHK026 - Are the help modal overlay styling (`BG_1`, `ACCENT_PRIMARY` border), categorization groups, and dismiss behaviors completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §5.5]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the practical ceiling behavior for partitions exceeding 100 communities defined as standard scrolling and modulo color reuse rather than error state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §SC-010]

## 6. Accessibility & Contrast Measurability

- [x] CHK028 - Are all documented foreground-background color pairs verified to achieve at least 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast ratio? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, Data-Model §6]
- [x] CHK029 - Is non-color visual redundancy (symbols and distinct shapes alongside color tokens) specified for all critical state indicators? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001, Spec §US-6]
- [x] CHK030 - Are keyboard navigation specifications complete such that 100% of user interactions are operable without pointer/mouse input? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Constraints]

---

## 7. Architecture, Constitution & Lint Discipline

- [x] CHK031 - Are all style preset functions specified as `pub const fn` to satisfy strict linting and compile-time evaluation constraints? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §II]
- [x] CHK032 - Are documentation requirements (`///` comments on all `pub` items) specified to comply with `missing_docs = deny`? [Completeness, Plan §Constraints, Constitution §IV]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the module organization confirmed as internal submodules (`src/ui/colors.rs` and `src/ui/styles.rs`) within `leiden-tui` rather than an isolated external crate? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the render loop frame execution budget (<50 ms per frame at 20 FPS) quantified and accompanied by non-blocking channel drain requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Performance Goals]
